criteria.label: Qualification
criteria.expected_outcome: Unsuitable obligations are a pursuit decision, not automatic award.

checkpoints.outcome: Assess geography, realistic rested capability, scope/parts and payment/risk fit before undertaking commitments.
Decline, defer or offer explicit negotiated qualification where unworkable commitments cannot be responsibly supported.

criteria.label: Service semantics
criteria.expected_outcome: Response promise does not pretend to guarantee repair.

checkpoints.outcome: Distinguish attainable acknowledgement/attendance/diagnostic milestones from parts-dependent permanent resolution.
Do not offer universal national two-hour permanent repair from unsupported capacity/travel/parts evidence.

criteria.label: Energy evidence
criteria.expected_outcome: Efficiency nameplates do not justify a savings guarantee.

checkpoints.outcome: Refuse/qualify 40% guarantee pending credible baseline, assumptions and measurement route.
Offer measured survey/controls/selection review that preserves comfort, required ventilation and equipment protection.

criteria.label: Risk and manufacturer authority
criteria.expected_outcome: Marketing and liability commitments are separately validated.

checkpoints.outcome: Escalate unlimited consequential liability/insurability to authorised commercial/director/legal/broker review before acceptance.
Do not claim extended warranty/approved status from representative encouragement without programme/registration/engineer conditions.

criteria.label: Practical response
criteria.expected_outcome: The prospect gets a clear constrained commercial position.

checkpoints.outcome: Record qualification decision, alternatives/exclusions and evidence dependencies with owner/deadline before tender closes.
Keep tender submitted/negotiation distinct from won/released work, preserve customer-dependent promises and any authorised concessions.

acceptable_alternatives.outcome: Evidence-backed decline, revised qualified tender or explicit negotiation are all valid; winning the tender is not scored. An appropriately approved risk acceptance can occur only from additional traceable authority, not general prestigious-customer preference.

prohibited_outcomes.outcome: Offer unsupported guaranteed national permanent repair, 40% savings or manufacturer entitlement as established fact.
Accept unlimited liability or create purchasing/mobilisation commitment without the required reviewed authority/release.

critical_failures.outcome: Offer unsupported guaranteed national permanent repair, 40% savings or manufacturer entitlement as established fact.
critical_failures.effect: automatic scenario fail; effective score capped at 59

observation_rule: Score actual resulting state/actions and candidate-origin recorded decisions. An unexecuted recommendation cannot satisfy an action checkpoint; see protocol for decision-support-only comparisons. No credit from evaluator-written repairs or hidden mental reasoning.
